title: DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.32294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model-aware online data selection prioritizes the training documents that contribute the most given the model's current state. Existing online selectors rank candidates upon gradient-based data utility scores, which requires the full forward-backward pass of the main model on every candidate document. Scoring each document therefore pays as much as training on it, yet only a small fraction is used for the real model update. We introduce DAiSy, a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, which eliminates the computation overhead and infrastructure burdens. The linear estimator is updated alongside the main language model, fitting to the exact gradient-based utility scores obtained from the backward pass of regular training steps. Consequently, scoring a candidate requires only a linear transformation, bypassing the costly gradient-alignment computation. We demonstrate

translated_title: DAiSy：基于自适应效用估计的大语言模型预训练在线数据选择
translated_abstract: 模型感知的在线数据选择会优先挑选在模型当前状态下贡献最大的训练文档。现有的在线选择器基于梯度的数据效用分数对候选文档进行排序，这要求对每个候选文档执行主模型的完整前向-反向传播。因此，对每个文档进行评分的代价与在它上面训练的代价相当，但其中只有一小部分文档被真正用于模型更新。我们提出了DAiSy，一个轻量级的线性辅助模型，它学习从冻结的文档嵌入中预测数据效用分数，从而消除了计算开销和基础设施负担。该线性估计器与主语言模型同步更新，拟合常规训练步骤反向传播中获得的精确的基于梯度的效用分数。因此，对候选文档进行评分只需一次线性变换，绕过了代价高昂的梯度对齐计算。我们证明了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DAiSy通过一个与主模型同步更新的轻量级线性辅助模型，从冻结的文档嵌入预测基于梯度的数据效用分数，使在线数据选择中每个候选文档的评分仅需一次线性变换，从而消除了大语言模型预训练中数据选择高昂的计算开销。
en_tdlr: DAiSy introduces a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict gradient-based data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, so scoring each candidate requires only a linear transformation, eliminating the costly forward-backward computation in online data selection for LLM pretraining.
